definitions.explanation: The mental strength to face difficult, frightening, or risky situations without flinching. Often refers to a bold, fearless disposition.

examples.japanese: {度胸|どきょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧{度胸|どきょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I don't have the nerve to speak my mind directly to the president.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{度胸|どきょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{据|す}わって⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧、⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}いている→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧。
examples.english: She has nerves of steel and stays calm in any situation.

notes:
USAGE: {度胸|どきょう} refers to boldness and nerve in the face of difficulty. It implies an admirable quality of being unfazed by pressure.

The expression {度胸|どきょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{据|す}わって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ means "having nerves of steel" or "being unflappable."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {度胸|どきょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have guts/nerve
- {度胸|どきょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to lack courage
- {度胸|どきょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{据|す}わる: to have nerves of steel
- {度胸|どきょう}{試|だめ}し: test of courage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {度胸|どきょう}: boldness, nerve (practical courage in the moment)
- ⟦{勇気|ゆうき}→勇気：02499_yuuki⟧: courage, bravery (general, noble courage)
- ⟦{根性|こんじょう}→根性：19215_konjou⟧: grit, determination (persevering spirit)
